question_text:
You are developing a method for an application that uses the Translator API.
The method will receive the content of a webpage, and then translate the content into Greek (el). The result will also contain a transliteration that uses the Roman alphabet.
You need to create the URI for the call to the Translator API.
You have the following URI.
https://api.cognitive.microsofttranslator.com/translate?api-version=3.0
Which three additional query parameters should you include in the URI? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
discussion:
C, D and F are correct answers. 
textType=html
to=el
toScript=Latn

textType=html is CORRECT because the content of a webpage is typically in HTML format. Specifying textType=html ensures that the Translator API correctly interprets and processes the HTML content.

to=el is CORRECT because you need to specify the target language for translation. to=el indicates that the content should be translated into Greek.

toScript=Latn is CORRECT because you want the transliteration to use the Roman alphabet. toScript=Latn specifies that the transliteration should be in the Latin script.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cognitive-services/translator/reference/v3-0-translate
- to
Specifies the language of the output text. The target language must be one of the supported languages included in the translation scope. For example, use to=de to translate to German.
It's possible to translate to multiple languages simultaneously by repeating the parameter in the query string. For example, use to=de&to=it to translate to German and Italian.
- textType
Defines whether the text being translated is plain text or HTML text. Any HTML needs to be a well-formed, complete element. Possible values are: plain (default) or html.
